description: Department of Local Government - Central Province - Declare that K. G. U. Kumarasinghe as Chairman of the Tumpane Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette contains a notification under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) regarding the declaration of a Chairman for a local government authority (Thumpane Pradeshiya Sabha). It specifically references Section 66g of the election ordinance and includes a schedule with electoral district, local authority, and elected official information. This content falls squarely within electoral processes and declarations, making it an Elections Gazette.
